sloka: तं विसृज्य ततो रामो वयस्यमकुतोभयम् ।प्रतर्दनं काशिपतिं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.३८.१६ ॥
transliteration: taṁ visṛjya tato rāmo vayasyamakutobhayam ।pratardanaṁ kāśipatiṁ pariṣvajyedamabravīt ।। 7.38.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, having dismissed that fearless friend, Rama embraced Pratardana, the lord of Kashi, and spoke this.
